                    ### Question
                    Which of the following alterations in amino acid metabolism is caused by a deficit of vitamin B12 ?:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Methyl-malonic acidemia.
opb. Phenylketonuric hyperphenylalaninemia.
opc. Hypertirosinemia type I.
opd. Alcaptonuria.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Vitamin B12 deficiency leads to impaired conversion of methylmalonyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA, resulting in Methyl-malonic acidemia. This is the alteration in amino acid metabolism caused by a deficit of vitamin B12.
